title: Sharp even coefficient identity
statement: Let $r$ and $l$ be natural numbers with $0<r$ and $l\le r$. Write $\eta_r=1/\sqrt{2r-1}$ and $B_{r,l}=(2r-1)^l\binom{r}{l}/\binom{2r}{2l}$. Then $\binom{2r}{2l}\eta_r^{2l}B_{r,l}=\binom{r}{l}$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a natural number with $l\le r$
